SELECT pr.id, pr.name, pr.description, pr.price, pr.stock, pr.created_at, pr.updated_at, s3.s3_key as s3_s3_key, s3.sort_order as s3_sort_order, s3.is_main_image as s3_is_main_image FROM products pr LEFT JOIN S3_files s3 ON pr.id = s3.entity_id AND s3.entity_type = 1 AND s3.del_flg = false WHERE pr.id = #{productId} AND pr.del_flg = false ORDER BY s3.sort_order ASC
